title: The Terminal of Kepler Reach Revisited
author: Beatrix Oyelaran
blurb: Tamsin Nystrom, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
